content.value: An illumination on the working plane of 3footcandle is requiredon a rom 1 270'x50'. The lamps are required to be hung 15ft. above the work benches. Assuming space-height ratio of 1.25, utilization factor of 0.5 and a candle power depreciation of 20%, estimate the number, rating and disposition of suitable lamps. Efficiency of a lamp may be taken as 0.5 watt per candle power.

_source_title: B. Arch 3rd Year Special Backlog Examination, 2022
